titles.romaji: VINLAND SAGA SEASON 2: Drowning in the Shadow
titles.native: ヴィンランド・サガ SEASON2 Drowning in the Shadow

description:
Episode 6.5 of VINLAND SAGA SEASON 2.

The short video depicts a scene not shown in the anime where Thorfinn, as he appears as a member of Askeladd's raiders, cuts down some men in the middle of a raid. When he enters a nearby house, he sees a family cowering within...

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
